scope: Independent source review and earlier independent Node tests; inspected the root-run native Chromium release report. No additional browser or heavy simulation was run by this reviewer in the final pass.

browserReportReview.note: Native new-game combat consumes a variable number of rolls; this release report supersedes the earlier 343-assertion report.

findings.result: openDialog cancels settingsFocus by default. Only the settingsPanel:true caller retains it, closing the previously suggested cross-dialog stale-request boundary. That old edge was theoretical, not a native reproduced defect.

An open dialog prevents restoration. A consumed one-shot request requires unchanged screen/view/runId and a visible enabled settings control. A new unrelated active control wins; focus uses preventScroll.

Sound updates the existing aria-checked switch without remounting the scene or dialog. SETTINGS_KEY write failure retains the modal notice and session preference. Native readback, reload and failure cases passed; game save stays equal.

Return-to-top runs after successful committed state changes, only in the compact game view. No-op and failed writes return earlier. before.phase and after.phase both fusion bypass it, preserving in-room lock/fuse/salvage scrolling. Native scrolled fusion lock passed.

ActionFocus, fusion DOM and inventory DOM helpers remain baseline-identical. Explicit compact navigation resets page/current-room position; ordinary redraws, filters and inventory transactions retain their established policies. Desktop and open-dialog navigation skip the new reset.

Case exceptions record FAIL; browser errors, source changes, failed cases and an empty --case selection set failure exit status. Only failure-screenshot capture is ignored after the case is already failed. eq now uses isDeepStrictEqual consistently with its assertion.

Protected fusion material now truly triggers review. Native cancellation preserves exact state; confirmation matches one engine transaction and consumes the material once. Prior unprotected-fixture and trace key-order issues are corrected in the authoritative rerun.

boundaries: This report does not certify physical phones, physical GPUs, browser zoom or screen readers.
Source hashes and served release metadata are checked by the driver; full HTTP/package byte identity is a separate packaging gate.
The previously reproduced historical-item alias divergence remains OPEN_P3_REPRODUCED_NOT_FIXED. See docs/iteration/evidence/round11/save-alias-summary.json; this round does not claim to fix it.
Core save and rules source remains unchanged. Earlier save closure, 5MB boundaries and three baseline/current fingerprints remain documented in audit/save-audits-comparison.json.
